output.answer: As of the latest official FINRA settlement date of October 30, 2026, AST SpaceMobile (NASDAQ: ASTS) had 67,537,225 shares sold short — 25.34% of its float (~22.5% of shares outstanding) — with days-to-cover of 5.08, up 2.53% (+1.67 million shares) from the prior period. Short interest has climbed steadily through 2026, from about 40.8 million shares (27.1% of float) in late January to 67.5 million shares, and real-time estimates put it near 22.8% of float with borrow utilization at 92.78% — near scarcity levels that raise squeeze risk.
caveats: Official short interest is reported biweekly with a ~2-week lag: the 67,537,225-share figure is the settlement-date position as of 2026-10-30 and may not reflect current positioning; ASTS traded at $36.73 (+9.0%) intraday on 2026-11-11 after a -8.67% close the prior day, so the live figure has likely moved.

Percent-of-float figures differ by denominator: ChartExchange shows 25.34% of float (266,476,717 float shares), while AltIndex shows 22.53% of total shares outstanding (299,789,305) for the same 67.5 million shares short; ORTEX's real-time estimate is ~22.8% of float.
ORTEX's 22.8%-of-float figure is a real-time estimate, not the official FINRA settlement data.
